long_biography.plain_text:
The dealership bearing Criswell's surname was founded by his father in Gaithersburg in 1972. Harry III subsequently became its leading dealer, preserving the family identity while extending the operation beyond one Chevrolet outlet. By 2008, his portfolio included Honda, Nissan and Hummer franchises alongside a growing used-car business and dedicated sales facilities.

His management has emphasized both physical expansion and changing retail methods. He adopted early internet sales, invested in certified pre-owned operations and refused to compromise vehicle quality for volume. He leads a substantial Maryland-and-Virginia group and has addressed manufacturer strategy, dealership closures and the economics of franchised retail in public commentary.
